entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I just bought.
I can certainly help you with that. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Look, I **don't have time** for a big back-and-forth. The readings are all over the place. It's basically a piece of **garbage**. I need to start the return process now.

I understand your frustration, and I'm sorry to hear the device isn't performing as expected. If it's a technical fault, I'm required to first offer a transfer to our technical support team. They can typically resolve these sensor issues very quickly...
No. I'm not interested in that. I'm busy, and I **just want money** back for a product that doesn't work. Can you process a **refund**, yes or no?

Yes, I can. Let me just pull up your account information here... one moment. Okay, I see you're a VIP member with us, Mr. Evans. Thank you for your loyalty. I can see the VeloBand was delivered just five days ago.
That's right. So are we doing this or not?
Absolutely. According to our policy, you have 10 days from the date of delivery for a full refund, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe. I've gone ahead and authorized the return.

I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Simply package the item in its original box, affix the label, and drop it at any post office. As soon as our warehouse scans it in, your refund will be processed. For the inconvenience, and as a thank you for being a VIP member, I've also added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
